data.gender_notes: Musefah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘Al-Muhsin’ which means ‘the wise’, ‘the one who gives’, or ‘the one who does good’. Musefah is a name that embodies wisdom, intelligence, and a keen sense of understanding. The name Musefah carries the meaning “Intelligent, Wise” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Musefah usually hope their child will grow to embody intelligent, wise and live with faith, good character and purpose.
